cards.audioText: [Your callsign is CES243, an A320 is on T22 A arrival for runway 18L. You have been told to contact Wuhan Approach. You are 5 miles south of T VOR. You have a fire warning in the cockpit. You notice that the left engine is on fire.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方243，一架A320以T22-A进场，跑道18左。你被告知联系武汉进近。你在TVOR以南5海里。你的驾驶舱内部出现火警告警。你注意到你的左侧发动机失火了。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CES243, 5 miles south of T VOR, left engine on fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY，武汉进近，东方243，T VOR以南5海里，左发动机失火。

cards.audioText: CES243, roger MAYDAY, you are number one to the airport. Descend via T22 A Arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，收到MAYDAY，你第一个落地。通过T22-A下降。
cards.referenceText: No. 1, descend via T-22A Arrival, CES243.

cards.audioText:
CES243, when able state fuel on board and POB.
[Tell the controller you have 8000kg fuel on board and POB is 161.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方243，方便的时候，报告机上燃油和人员。
[告诉管制员，机上燃油8000千克，人员161。]
cards.referenceText: We have 8000kg fuel on board and POB is 161, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们有8000千克燃油，机上人员161，东方243。

cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，方便的时候，应答机7700。

cards.audioText: CES243, turn to heading 020 for a short vector around VFR traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，航向020，短引导绕过目视飞行航空器。
cards.referenceText: Heading 020, short vector, traffic in sight, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航向020，短引导，冲突可见，东方243。

cards.audioText: CES243, emergency equipment will be standing by when you land.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，当你落地时，紧急设备将随时待命。

cards.audioText:
CES243, contact tower on 135.00 when you turn final. You are cleared visual approach runway 18 left or right, your choice.
[Tell controller you will take runway 18L.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方243，当你转向五边的时候，联系塔台135.00，你可以目视进近跑道18左或者18右，你的选择是？
[告诉管制员，你将使用跑道18左。]
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求跑道18左，联系塔台135.00，东方243。

cards.audioText: [During the descent to the airport, your flight attendant informs you that a passenger in the cabin is very ill, possibly have a heart attack. Inform ATC of your additional medical emergency.]
cards.audioTextZh: 在向机场下降过程中，你的客舱乘务员告知你客舱中有一名乘客病得很严重，可能是有心脏病，告知管制员额外的医疗紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES243, we have a sick passenger on board, possibly heart attack, request medical assistance after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方243，我们机上有一名病重乘客，可能是心脏病，请求着陆后医疗协助。

cards.audioText: CES243, understand you also have a medical emergency, now traffic no factor, turn 30 right to resume the T 22A arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，明白你也有医疗紧急情况，现在无冲突航空器，右转30度，重新加入T22-A进场程序。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, turn 30 right to resume T-22A Arrival, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，右转30度，重新加入T22-A进场程序。

cards.audioText: [You have done the engine fire checklist and have successfully extinguished the engine fire. Tell the controller you are going to stop on the taxiway first and have emergency equipment approach the aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你完成了发动机起火检查单，并且成功扑灭了发动机起火。告诉管制员，你会首先在滑行道上停下，然后需要紧急救援设备接近飞机]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES243, we are stopping on the taxiway, request emergency equipment approach us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方243，我们正在滑行道上停下，请求紧急设备接应。

cards.audioText: [After landing, tower confirms that there isn’t any smoke or fire visible from your left engine. Tell the ground controller to have the fire equipment follow you to the gate. Medical personnel ready to board the aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: [着陆之后，塔台确认从你的左引擎没有看到任何烟或明火。告诉地面管制让消防设备跟着你到机位。医务人员准备登机]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES243, request fire service follow us to the gate, we hope medical personnel can wait us there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方243，请求消防设备跟着我们到机位，我们希望医务人员可以在那里等我们。

cards.audioText: CES243, taxi via A, H to gate. Medical personnel will meet you at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，通过滑行道A，H到停机位，医务人员会在停机位等你们。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via A, H to gate, thanks, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过滑行道A，H到停机位，东方243。
